title: Text Ingestion & Memory
description: Store all shared summaries, messages, and custom ideas passively in a database buffer to preserve short-term chat context.

title: Webpage Scraping
description: Instantly fetch and clean the readable text of any shared URL (links, documentation, or code repos) in the background.

title: Web Search Interceptors
description: Fall back on live search command-line queries and custom wttr.in weather lookup to provide up-to-date answers.

title: Smart Agentic Loop
description: Iterative 5-turn reasoning loop letting the LLM decide which tool to call or when to formulate its final reply.

title: GSuite Integrations
description: Autonomous actions over connected GSuite accounts — search and read messages, send emails, and create calendar events.

title: Knowledge Graph Construction
description: Extract entities and relationships from captures, structuring them into a queryable knowledge graph stored in CockroachDB.
